Distribution. Until now, Anastomoneura was only recorded from the Serra da Mantiqueira mountain range, in Minas Gerais state, Southeastern Brazil. Larvae of this genus, probably belonging to A. guahybae, were found in 3 streams at São José do Barreiro, Serra da Bocaina National Park, São Paulo state. These records extend the distribution of the genus to the Serra do Mar mountain range and to lower altituds (1200 m): 3 rd order tributary of Córrego da Floresta, 22 o 42 ’ 46.7 ” S, 44 o 38 ’ 14.2 ” W, 1575 m; Córrego das Posses, 2 nd order stream, 22 o 46 ’ 06.6 ” S, 44 o 36 ’ 36.0 ” W, 1270 m; Ribeirão da Prata, 4 th order stream, 22 o 46 ’ 48.9 ” S, 44 o 36 ’ 40.4 ” W, 1200 m.
